Text: GLENMORE, June 8. A school-supply drive at Stonebridge Grocers, a company whose ten stores 131 ------- in neighborhoods across the city, closed on Friday with 6,200 items collected, far above its goal of 4,000. Nearly 900 132 ------- that had not taken part in earlier years contributed.\nDonations were left in bins at store entrances over six weeks, and the drive's forty volunteers, working after hours, sorted them into 200 boxes that teachers can open when classes begin. The company's sixty employees also helped, mainly to check the count. "Residents responded 133 ------- to a simple request," said Adele Kessler, who coordinated the drive.\nThe boxes will be delivered to twelve elementary schools in August, which will give teachers time to prepare before the new term. 134 -------.
